steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary as the buyer without searching or recreating the event setup.
Enable the eRFX project capability required by the setup.
Open the Recreate Order dialog from the event's Settings menu.
Confirm the Recreate Order dialog opened and shows its product configuration section.
Confirm the recreate dialog exposes the scheduling choice.
Choose the requested four-hour event end duration.
Verify the duration control retained the selected 4 Hrs value.
Create the recreated order using the selected duration and the existing default evaluation and scheduling choices.
Verify the recreated event retains the prepared RFQ's line-item quantity.
